core: NOTCH intracellular domain transcriptional output
qualifier: NOTCH2/3/4 receptors and lineage-fate targets, not NOTCH1 or its oncogenic mutants
name: NOTCH2-4 intracellular domain transcription in cell fate specification
rationale: All members concern released NOTCH intracellular domains driving target transcription and the fates they specify (Th2, pancreatic bud, Notch-HLH, RUNX3 input), while every confusable is built around NOTCH1 activation, constitutive NOTCH1 mutants and generic Notch-signalling regulation.

core: inhibitory adrenergic receptor signalling
qualifier: Gi/Gz coupling that lowers adenylyl cyclase and restrains catecholamine release
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/Gz suppression of cyclase and catecholamine release
rationale: Every member is alpha-2/Gz adrenergic signalling that inhibits adenylyl cyclase and damps epinephrine, norepinephrine or insulin secretion, whereas the confusables cover generic cAMP/PKA handling, cardiac stimulation and vascular tone.

core: spinal cord and neural plate dorsoventral patterning
qualifier: motor neuron and ventral interneuron fate, floor plate and ventral midline
name: Spinal cord dorsoventral patterning and motor neuron fate specification
rationale: All members pattern the neural plate and spinal cord along the dorsoventral axis and specify its motor neurons, interneurons and floor plate, while the confusables are hindbrain/brainstem, midbrain dopaminergic or axial mesoderm themes.

core: circadian transcriptional control of glucose metabolism
qualifier: gluconeogenesis and pancreatic beta cell development under nutrient and redox state
name: Circadian transcriptional control of gluconeogenesis and pancreatic beta cell state
rationale: Members couple clock transcription factors (BMAL1:CLOCK, NPAS2, NPAS4, locomotor rhythm) to glucose output and beta cell development under caloric and redox state, whereas the confusables are PGC-1alpha/PPARA mitochondrial-metabolic or glucocorticoid themes.

core: myeloid lineage identity and activation expression modules
qualifier: monocyte and neutrophil effector and degradative program, not surface-marker or TLR-inflammatory modules
name: Monocyte-neutrophil myeloid identity and activation program
rationale: All members are blood modules and processes marking the monocyte/macrophage/neutrophil lineage and its activation and secretory-degradative capacity, while the confusables are monocyte or dendritic cell surface signatures and TLR/inflammatory-response themes.

core: iron-sulfur cluster assembly
qualifier: cluster delivery to TCA enzymes and control of tetrapyrrole and hemoglobin output
name: Iron-sulfur cluster assembly with downstream enzyme and tetrapyrrole control
rationale: Every member concerns building 2Fe-2S/4Fe-4S clusters, exporting their precursors and the enzymes and tetrapyrrole regulation that depend on them, whereas the confusables are heme biosynthesis proper, ferredoxin-dependent steroidogenesis and complex III assembly.

core: dietary lipid uptake and triglyceride-rich lipoprotein assembly
qualifier: intestinal absorption and sterol entry control, not circulating particle remodelling
name: Intestinal dietary lipid absorption and triglyceride-rich lipoprotein assembly
rationale: All members cover digestion and intestinal absorption of dietary lipid and sterols and the assembly of chylomicrons and VLDL that carry them, while the confusables are plasma lipoprotein remodelling, clearance and efflux themes.

core: mRNA 3'-end processing with transcription termination and nuclear export
qualifier: polyadenylated and SLBP-dependent histone routes plus snRNP/snRNA handling
name: mRNA 3'-end processing, transcription termination and nuclear export
rationale: Every member concerns forming an mRNA 3' end (cleavage/polyadenylation or histone stem-loop), terminating Pol II, and moving the mature transcript or snRNA through the pore, whereas the confusables are spliceosome, mRNA decay or snRNA transcription themes.

core: innate receptor signalling in antigen-presenting myeloid cells
qualifier: TLR/MyD88 and CD40 input together with its negative tuning
name: Monocyte-dendritic TLR and CD40 signalling with negative feedback restraint
rationale: All members are TLR/MyD88, CD40 and complement receptor signalling in monocytes and dendritic cells together with the brakes on it and on MHC class II, while the confusables are Fc receptor/neutrophil degranulation modules or cytokine-production regulation.

core: very-long-chain and polyunsaturated fatty acyl-CoA metabolism
qualifier: peroxisomal beta-oxidation and ether/plasmalogen lipid synthesis
name: Very-long-chain fatty acyl-CoA synthesis, beta-oxidation and ether lipid biosynthesis
rationale: Members build and degrade very-long-chain and polyunsaturated acyl-CoAs in the peroxisome and use them for ether and plasmalogen lipids, whereas the confusables are peroxisomal protein import, sterol biosynthesis and alpha-oxidation/branched-chain themes.

core: clostridial neurotoxin blockade of neurotransmitter release
qualifier: SNARE cleavage by botulinum and tetanus toxin serotypes
name: Clostridial neurotoxin cleavage of SNAREs blocking neurotransmitter release
rationale: All members are the toxicity routes of botulinum serotypes and tetanus toxin, which cleave synaptic SNAREs, while every confusable is normal neurotransmitter transport, loading or clearance.

core: APC/C-dependent ubiquitin-mediated degradation in late mitosis
qualifier: Cdc20/Cdh1 switching at the metaphase-anaphase transition and mitotic exit
name: APC/C-dependent degradation driving metaphase-anaphase transition and mitotic exit
rationale: Every member concerns the APC/C, its Cdc20-to-Cdh1 switch, its inhibitors (Emi1, phosphorylation) and the substrates it destroys to pass anaphase and exit mitosis, whereas the confusables are G2/M entry, spindle and sister-chromatid cohesion themes.

core: glycerophospholipid synthesis and acyl-chain remodelling
qualifier: head-group classes including cardiolipin plus the N-acylethanolamine/endocannabinoid arm
name: Glycerophospholipid synthesis, acyl-chain remodelling and N-acylethanolamine signalling
rationale: All members make, hydrolyse or re-acylate diacyl glycerophospholipids (PC, PE, PS, PG, PI, CL) and the N-acylethanolamines derived from them, while the confusables are sphingolipid metabolism, lipid transfer between membranes, or phosphatidic acid and triglyceride synthesis.

core: plasma lipoprotein particle remodelling and clearance
qualifier: receptor-mediated uptake and cholesterol import control, not particle assembly or absorption
name: Plasma lipoprotein remodelling and receptor-mediated clearance
rationale: Every member concerns remodelling circulating HDL, LDL, VLDL and chylomicrons and clearing them with the cholesterol import and storage that follows, whereas the confusables add intestinal absorption and particle assembly, lipase assembly or foam cell formation.

core: COPI-coated vesicle traffic
qualifier: intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER retrograde direction
name: COPI-mediated intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER retrograde transport
rationale: All members are COPI budding and the retrograde and intra-Golgi routes it serves, while the confusables are vesicle tethering, trans-Golgi/lysosome biogenesis, Golgi structural reorganization or COPII anterograde exit from the ER.

core: retinoid metabolism and retinoic acid signalling
qualifier: visual cycle chromophore regeneration and its inherited failures
name: Retinoid metabolism, visual cycle regeneration and retinoic acid signalling
rationale: Every member handles vitamin A derivatives: their metabolism and catabolism, retinoic acid response, and regeneration of the visual chromophore including the disease events that break it, whereas the confusables are vitamin D/K metabolism, the phototransduction cascade itself, or steroidogenic cytochromes.

core: oncogene-induced senescence
qualifier: heterochromatin-based proliferative arrest, not secretory phenotype or oxidative-stress senescence
name: Oncogene-induced senescence with heterochromatin-mediated proliferative arrest
rationale: All members concern entry into and control of oncogene-induced senescence and the senescence-associated heterochromatin that locks the arrest, while the confusables add the secretory phenotype, oxidative-stress and replicative senescence, and p16/p14ARF evasion.

core: receptor-mediated potentiation of insulin secretion
qualifier: incretin, free fatty acid and cholinergic ligands acting on the beta cell
name: Ligand-receptor potentiation of beta cell insulin secretion
rationale: All three members are beta cell surface receptors (GLP-1, GPR40/FFAR1, muscarinic) amplifying insulin secretion, whereas the confusables are insulin processing and beta cell identity, adrenergic inhibition of secretion, or other glucagon-family receptor themes.

core: apoptotic and necroptotic execution machinery
qualifier: death receptor and BH3-only/BAX-BAK mitochondrial arms with caspase and nuclease execution, not p53 transcriptional input
name: Death receptor and BCL-2-family apoptotic execution with necroptosis
rationale: Every member is part of triggering or restraining cell death at the protein level: death receptor and caspase-8 signalling, BH3-only activation of BAX/BAK and cytochrome c release, apoptosome and nuclease execution, and RIPK1-dependent necroptosis, whereas the confusables supply the p53 transcriptional and senescence programs that act upstream.

core: sulfated glycosaminoglycan chain biosynthesis on proteoglycans
qualifier: heparan, heparin, chondroitin and dermatan chain polymerization including EXT1/EXT2 failure
name: Heparan, chondroitin and dermatan sulfate chain polymerization on proteoglycans
rationale: All members build GAG chains onto proteoglycan cores and the exostosin defects that block heparan sulfate elongation, whereas the confusables concern the shared linkage-region tetrasaccharide, chondroitin sulfotransferase defects, or O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation of NOTCH.

core: regulated arachidonate release and prostaglandin output
qualifier: phospholipase A2 activation and prostaglandin response including fever, not the cyclooxygenase or lipoxygenase enzymology
name: Phospholipase A2 arachidonate release and prostaglandin output control
rationale: Members concern PLA2-driven liberation and secretion of arachidonate and the up- and down-regulation of prostaglandin synthesis and response (including fever), while the confusables are the COX and prostaglandin/thromboxane synthetic steps, leukotriene and lipoxin branches, and prostanoid receptors.

core: immunological synapse assembly and lymphocyte polarity
qualifier: membrane raft clustering and lymphocyte aggregation at the contact site
name: Immunological synapse assembly and lymphocyte polarity with membrane raft clustering
rationale: All four members describe polarizing a lymphocyte onto a cell-cell contact and organizing rafts into a synapse, whereas the confusables are chemokine/GPCR and Rho GTPase signalling or integrin-mediated adhesion and migration signatures.

core: RNA polymerase I and III transcription with cytoplasmic translation initiation
qualifier: rRNA and tRNA synthesis and early rRNA cleavage feeding 43S/80S initiation and elongation
name: RNA polymerase I and III transcription with cytoplasmic translation initiation
rationale: Every member is either Pol I/Pol III synthesis of rRNA and tRNA with the first rRNA cleavages, or assembly of the ternary and 43S initiation complexes and chain elongation that consume those products, whereas the confusables are chromatin regulators of rRNA expression, MYC target programs and snRNA transcription.

core: oligodendrocyte myelination of the central nervous system
qualifier: progenitor proliferation, myelin maintenance and its negative regulation, with reactive gliosis
name: Oligodendrocyte central nervous system myelination and its regulation
rationale: All members concern the oligodendrocyte lineage forming, maintaining and limiting CNS myelin and the glial reaction around it, while the confusables are astrocyte activation, Schwann cell/peripheral myelin and node assembly, or axon regeneration.

core: axial patterning of the early embryo
qualifier: neural plate and neural tube regionalization with somite and axial mesoderm specification
name: Neural plate, neural tube and somite axial patterning
rationale: Every member patterns the embryonic axis itself - forming and regionalizing the neural plate and tube, specifying its neurons and midline, and segmenting the paraxial and axial mesoderm - whereas the confusables are Hox-cluster limb and digit morphogenesis or craniofacial and pharyngeal organ development.
